answer: Prayers & Duties >> Hajj & Umrah Question ID: 21821 Country: India Title: Mufti saab, this year I have made niyaah of performing Hajj & Umrah with my parents and my grand mother. Can you please give me a complete detail of performing Hajj & Umrah, also i love to do ghidmath of my parents alot, can you help me in knowing how to do khidmath of my parents till my last breath, obey them, obey Allah swt's commands and everything. It will be great if you reply asap. Question: Mufti saab, this year I have made niyaah of performing Hajj & Umrah with my parents and my grand mother. Can you please give me a complete detail of performing Hajj & Umrah, also i love to do ghidmath of my parents alot, can you help me in knowing how to do khidmath of my parents till my last breath, obey them, obey Allah swt's commands and everything. It will be great if you reply asap. Answer ID: 21821 Posted on: Aug 30, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 886/720/B=1431) Your intention is too much blessed. It is a blessing for you to take your parents and grandmother for hajj. According to the situation, assume the act which is of relief and easiness for your parents, get yourself busy all the time in doing their service and fulfilling their needs. Seek their advice and always try to keep them content. Obey and comply with them and do not raise your voice above their voice. Always prefer their comfort. For the Masael of hajj get the book Muallimul Hujjaj or Anwar-e-Manasik and study them repeatedly. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
